data.name: All The Little People
data.detailed_description:
A NEW PAWN HAS ENTERED THE GAME!

Rowan opens his eyes at the edge of a cliff.

The sunlight against his skin reminds him that he is still alive, while every breath he takes carries a trace of his past. He does not have a single coin in his pocket—or a single memory of yesterday in his mind.

Still, a nobleman always begins life one step ahead.

After all, every noble has loyal servants ready to serve them and a backup plan for when things go wrong.

But will Rowan truly become the hero of this journey?

Or is he merely the newest pawn in a much greater game?

HOW DOES THE JOURNEY UNFOLD?

All The Little People is a single-player fantasy role-playing game that combines story-driven exploration, choice-based dialogue, and turn-based combat.

Although Rowan begins his journey alone, his path crosses with different characters as the story unfolds. These characters are more than party members who accompany him in battle—they are also part of the events, mysteries, and choices connected to the approaching end of the world. Develop their abilities, manage their equipment, and make use of their complementary strengths in turn-based encounters.

However, Rowan’s journey is not limited to the enemies standing in his way. An indescribable voice echoes within his mind, guiding him through questions of life’s meaning, the future, and the tasks placed before him. But which path will ultimately satisfy you?

As you explore different regions, investigate the cosmic layers hidden beneath the world’s visible surface. Question who acts of their own free will, who is controlled by invisible strings, and where Rowan belongs within this greater order.

DEMO COMING SOON!

Wishlist the game to be notified when it releases and to support its development!

data.short_description: In this little world, you have a big mission to accomplish. To complete it, you'll find companions, participate in battles, and mingle with people. But you mustn't forget why you embarked on this path. As everything comes and goes, what game will all these little people become a part of?
